mapper.insert: insert into community ( community_content, file_path, file_public_id, created_at, updated_at, community_view_count, community_like_count, community_reply_count, community_deleted, user_no) values (#{communityContent}, #{filePath}, #{filePublicId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{communityViewCount}, #{communityLikeCount}, #{communityReplyCount}, #{communityDeleted}, 1);
